title: The url identity helper does not normalise // and dot segments or a trailing-dot host, and reads x, x.git and x/.git as one repository
goal: kbpublic.location gives the same location for the urls of one remote repository whatever their repeated slashes, . and .. segments, trailing-dot host or doubled .git suffix (_repo_path takes posixpath.normpath of the path and strips every .git suffix, the host loses its trailing dot); for a local path it names only the first place git tries that exists, in the order x, x.git, x/.git, so one repository is matched and two repositories at x and x.git are not

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbpublic;a=kbpublic.location('https://example.com/org//repo','.');b=kbpublic.location('https://example.com/org/repo','.');ok=kbpublic.same_repository(a,b);print('double slash matched:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import kbpublic as k;L=lambda u:k.location(u,".");base=L("https://example.com/org/repo");same=[u for u in ("https://example.com/org//repo","https://example.com/org/./x/../repo","https://example.com./org/repo","https://example.com/org/repo.git.git","git@example.com:org//repo.git") if k.same_repository(L(u),base)];print(len(same),"of 5 match");sys.exit(0 if len(same)==5 and not k.same_repository(L("https://example.com/org/other"),base) else 1)

import sys,os,tempfile;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import kbpublic as k;d=tempfile.mkdtemp();[os.makedirs(os.path.join(d,n)) for n in ("x","x.git","y.git")];L=lambda n:k.location(os.path.join(d,n),d);a=k.same_repository(L("x"),L("x.git"));b=k.same_repository(L("y"),L("y.git"));print("x vs x.git same:",a,"y vs y.git same:",b);sys.exit(0 if (not a and b) else 1)

clauses.clause: kbpublic.location gives the same location for the urls of one remote repository whatever their repeated slashes, . and .. segments, trailing-dot host or doubled .git suffix (_repo_path takes posixpath.normpath of the path and strips every .git suffix, the host loses its trailing dot)
for a local path it names only the first place git tries that exists, in the order x, x.git, x/.git, so one repository is matched and two repositories at x and x.git are not

notes: Check 3 (test_prepush_e2e.py) passes before the work: it pins the url matching that must stay. kbpublic.location and same_repository feed is_public: the normalisation only widens what matches one repository, and x versus x.git splits two repositories that matched as one. Normalisation: _repo_path takes posixpath.normpath of the path and the host loses its trailing dot.
